Existing inference-time methods either correct every step unconditionally or select among samples without learned correction; both ignore per-step uncertainty, producing inconsistent results.
We introduce ACR-VLA, a lightweight adaptive pipeline that gates a learned residual correction on a per-step uncertainty signal. Two action samples drawn in a single batched forward pass provide a near-perfect proxy for multi-sample variance at no additional latency; a compact correction module fires only when uncertainty exceeds a calibrated threshold.
